annotations.title: Elegir un vuelo u hotel del viaje

description: Choose one of the flight or hotel options Wizzo showed in trip_chat, for the trip `trip_id`: `kind` is "vuelo" or "hotel", `cache_id` is the card's cache_id and `id` the option's id. It saves the choice in the trip (as the web does when the traveller taps «Elegir») and tells Wizzo, who answers with the next step. Only choose what the traveller picked. A choice made by tapping «Elegir» on the card is already saved: do not call trip_choose for it, read Wizzo's answer with trip_chat and the turn_id you were given.

cache_id.description: The cache_id of the card the option came from.

id.description: The id of the chosen option.
